origine_fr: En bas, 言, la parole ; en haut, 折 (扌 et 斤), qui donnait le son mais se lit zhé, loin de shì. C'est la parole qui engage. C'est le serment : 发誓, jurer.
origine_en: Below, 言, speech; on top, 折 (扌 and 斤), which gave the sound but is read zhé, far from shì. These are words that bind you. It is an oath: 发誓, to swear.

phrase.pinyin: Tā fāshì zài yě bù hē jiǔ le.
phrase.fr: Il a juré de ne plus jamais boire.
phrase.en: He swore never to drink again.
